metadata.definition: One row per PhD-granting institution named in the people database (the OM List import and the operations faculty found on the faculty pages linked from the universities database). "people" counts people in the database with that doctorate (peopleBySource splits them by source), not the program's graduates. First-job figures count verified first jobs only; unresolved and pending people are listed separately and never inferred. Names that differ only in accents, punctuation, spacing or case are one row; "spellings" lists the variants as written in the source files.
